request_trace.user:
Generate a complete, production-ready JMeter JMX test plan.

## API Endpoints
GET /products - List products with pagination and filters (params: page, limit, category, status)
POST /products - Create a product (admin only) [body: application/json]
GET /products/{id} - Get product by ID (params: id)
PUT /products/{id} - Update a product (admin only) (params: id) [body: application/json]
DELETE /products/{id} - Delete a product (admin only) (params: id)
GET /cart/items - List current user's cart items
POST /cart/items - Add product to cart (merge and accumulate quantity if exists) [body: application/json]
PUT /cart/items/{itemId} - Update cart item quantity (params: itemId) [body: application/json]
DELETE /cart/items/{itemId} - Remove cart item (params: itemId)
GET /orders - List current user's orders (params: page, limit, status)
POST /orders - Create order from cart (requires non-empty cart, decrements stock) [body: application/json]
GET /orders/{id} - Get order by ID (owner only) (params: id)
POST /orders/{id}/cancel - Cancel an unpaid order (params: id)

## Configuration
- Virtual Users: 100
- Duration: 300 seconds
- Ramp-Up: 60 seconds
- Think Time: 500 ms
- Base URL: https://api.example.com
- Auth: none

## Requirements
1. Complete XML from <?xml ...?> to </jmeterTestPlan>
2. ThreadGroup with configured users/ramp-up/duration (ramp-up then steady state)
3. HTTP Request Defaults (server + port from Base URL), Cookie Manager, Cache Manager
4. HTTP Header Manager with Content-Type: application/json (and Authorization when Auth != none)
5. HTTP Samplers for EACH listed endpoint with realistic request bodies (from schema) for POST/PUT
6. Response Assertions for success status codes AND at least one key field
7. If Auth != none: a login sampler that extracts a token (JSON Extractor / Regular Expression Extractor) and reuses it via a Header Manager for subsequent samplers
8. Summary Report and Simple Data Writer listeners
9. (Cleanup) if any sampler creates data, add a teardown step that deletes it

Output ONLY raw JMX XML. Start with: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

Review the following JMeter JMX test plan and produce a COMPLETE revised version.

## Review Context (the script MUST stay consistent with this)
## Load Configuration

- virtual_users: 100
- duration_seconds: 300
- ramp_up_seconds: 60
- think_time_ms: 500
- auth_type: none

## Endpoint Signatures
- GET /products params:[category(string,opt,enum:electronics|clothing|food|home), limit(integer,opt), page(integer,opt), status(string,opt,enum:draft|published)]
- POST /products body:[category(string,opt,enum:electronics|clothing|food|home), name(string,req), price(number,req), sku(string,req), status(string,opt,enum:draft|published), stock(integer,req)]
- GET /products/{id} params:[id(integer,req)]
- PUT /products/{id} params:[id(integer,req)] body:[name(string,opt), price(number,opt), status(string,opt,enum:draft|published), stock(integer,opt)]
- DELETE /products/{id} params:[id(integer,req)]
- GET /cart/items
- POST /cart/items body:[productId(integer,req), quantity(integer,req)]
- PUT /cart/items/{itemId} params:[itemId(integer,req)] body:[quantity(integer,req)]
- DELETE /cart/items/{itemId} params:[itemId(integer,req)]
- GET /orders params:[limit(integer,opt), page(integer,opt), status(string,opt,enum:created|paid|shipped|completed|cancelled)]
- POST /orders body:[couponCode(string,opt)]
- GET /orders/{id} params:[id(integer,req)]
- POST /orders/{id}/cancel params:[id(integer,req)]

## Current Script
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<jmeterTestPlan version="1.2">
</jmeterTestPlan>

## Review Checklist
1. Load parameters match the context: ThreadGroup users / ramp-up / duration must equal the configured values.
2. Every endpoint listed in the context has an HTTP Sampler; POST/PUT samplers carry realistic bodies.
3. Assertions exist: success status codes AND at least one key response field per sampler.
4. Auth flow is coherent: when auth is enabled, a login sampler extracts the token and later samplers reuse it.
5. Structure is valid JMX: XML declaration, balanced tags, root <jmeterTestPlan>, listeners present.
6. Error handling: connection/response failures do not silently pass (assertions catch them).
7. Cleanup: data-creating samplers have matching teardown/cleanup steps.

## Output Contract
- Output the COMPLETE revised JMX XML, from <?xml ...?> to </jmeterTestPlan>.
- No explanations, no diff, no markdown fences — raw XML only.
- Preserve the original structure and naming where possible; change only what the checklist requires.
- If nothing needs to change, return the original script unchanged.
